items.title: Meta Ads: $50.11 spend, 4 leads, $12.53 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Yesterday (2026-09-15) Meta spent $50.11, all on the sole actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 4 leads at $12.53 CPL. That's in line with (slightly better than) the trailing 7-day baseline (2026-09-09 to 2026-09-15: $362.61 / 28 leads, ~$12.95 CPL), so no anomaly; account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged. Three other campaigns (Tiles Carasoul 1.99, Dead Stock Inventory Campaign Campaign, Real Estate List Building) remain PAUSED with no budget.

needs_attention: Checked up to 7 days back for the most recent prior meta-ads.json before pulling: none exists on this branch (claude/adoring-mendel-drqv24) more recent than 2026-09-08. Cross-branch verification (per the recurring branch-isolation pattern noted in the 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-15 runs) found a meta-ads.json for every day 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-15 on separate unmerged session branches (adoring-mendel-oygzuv/kfwm1s/yeuzjf/9dyo2m/n3quda/3mux4g/rnnx8m respectively). The most recent, 2026-09-15's run, covered through 2026-09-14 with status ok and no gap of its own — so there is no real coverage gap, and today's pull correctly used the standard 1-day window (2026-09-15) with no widening needed.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 4, exactly matching the counted leads), consistent with prior flags on 2026-08-31, 2026-09-02, 2026-09-07/08, and 2026-09-15. No discrepancy in the counted total, but this is now a long-recurring pattern across many runs — the script's LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set should be extended rather than continuing to hand-note it.
